summary: BSR Real Estate Investment Trust, a Canadian REIT dually listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim financial statements, MD&A and a November 11, 2026 press release covering third-quarter 2026 results, plus CEO and CFO certifications. No transaction, offer, strategic review or abrupt executive departure is disclosed; the filing is ordinary periodic reporting mapped to a US quarterly-report equivalent. Investment properties were carried at roughly $1.38 billion against loans and borrowings near $730 million. Watch for units trading near net asset value and any future strategic alternatives commentary, but no risk-arb angle exists.
